title: Configuration Management Engineer (Mid-level)
description:
To acquire the advantage, Zolon PCS is seeking a Mid-level Configuration Management Engineer to provide support and execution of
configuration control, as well as support for the Needs and Collection Management engineering board, NGA Engineering Review Board (ERB), and Configuration Control Board (CCB) as required. Lead Needs and Collection Management activities to baseline, analyze, update, and maintain the IT technical baseline in support of interoperability, integration of IT services/systems, and IT governance. Document Needs and Collection solution and
program epics in architecture and requirement artifacts, ICDs, ECPs, ECRs, RFCs, etc.

Duties may include:
Lead Quality Assurance of all RFCs at all stages of development.
Lead the development and maintenance of baselines.
Ensure the configuration management process is documented, introduced, and
implemented according to the process owner's guidelines. Conduct change and
configuration management at the project and program levels for systems, services, and
capabilities developed using traditional and agile methods.
Interface with the enterprise configuration management team.
Identify and implement opportunities in terms of process and tools to execute in a more
agile and efficient manner.
Lead and support configuration change tracking and documentation control to include,
but not limited to concepts of operation, requirements identification, and documentation,
preliminary and detailed system definition, systems and applications interfaces (point-to-point and APIs), system design review, performance monitoring tools, and production
software.
Guide Junior-level configuration managers performing configuration management
tasks.
Assist the government in validating and certifying system configuration changes.
Assist IPC Staff with engineering management and administrative tasks as directed.
Assist IPC Systems Engineers with Engineering Review Board (ERB) presentations.
Assist in ERB Confluence page updates and review.
Assist in assembling Pre-ERB and ERB agendas and distribution.
Assist in Pre-ERB note-taking and action items identified.
Assist in ERB action item tracking and updates.
Keep the Configuration Management Database (CMDB) updated.
Perform audits on CMDB and Configuration Items (CIs).
Interface with the Enterprise MBSE tools and provide input and extract data.
Serve as the configuration management authority for reviewing software code
deliveries and managing code libraries.

Required:
Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology,
Management Information Systems, or a related STEM degree.
Mid-level experience in Configuration and Change Management.
Mid-level experience in government or industry, establishing, managing, and/or leading
tool-based configuration management processes and practices for baselining traditional
and Agile-based efforts to include DevOps and Continuous Integration/Continuous
Deployment (CI/CD).

Desired:
Mid-level experience maintaining baseline and CMDB using platforms such as Remedy
and ServiceNow.
Demonstrated experience with MBSE, processes, tools, and languages.

Clearance: Top Secret/ SCI and (CI Poly eligible)
Location: Chantilly, VA (periodic Springfield, VA)
